On our newest episode of Dialogues on Technology and Society, Kent Walker sits down with biographer and historian Walter Isaacson to talk about why history's biggest breakthroughs have always been a team sport. title: Vercel Billing CLI is now available
description: You can now check your team’s billing overview, review and download invoices, and preview upcoming charges with the Vercel CLI . All billing commands, including usage, contracts, and budgets, are now grouped under vercel billing . Billing overview and invoice history are available on all plans, subject to your team’s existing billing permissions. Upcoming invoice estimates require an active paid subscription. Billing overview Check your team’s plan, billing status, billing cycle, balance due, and overdue invoices: In CLI 65.17.0 and later, this overview also includes configured invoice details such as your billing address, tax ID, and purchase order. Invoices and upcoming charges Use vercel billing invoices to review invoices, download PDFs, and preview upcoming charges. For inspect and download , replace <INVOICE_ID> with a full invoice ID from the list output: Upcoming charges are estimates and may change until the end of the billing period. For scripts and agents, add --json to vercel billing overview or any vercel billing invoices subcommand for structured output. Existing usage, contract, and budget commands now also use the same prefix: vercel usage → vercel billing usage vercel contract → vercel billing contract vercel budgets → vercel billing budgets The previous command names continue to work as aliases. To get started, update your Vercel CLI with vercel upgrade . Learn more in the Billing & Invoices documentation . Read more
